description: This file defines a PHP class 'BuzzFeedFilterParams' which extends a base 'FilterParams' class. It is used to specify filtering parameters for Buzz feed data, including sort fields, order, and specific identifiers such as 'shareId' and 'authUserEmpNumber'. The class includes getter and setter methods for these properties and initializes default sorting behavior in the constructor.

classes.name: BuzzFeedFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) for filtering Buzz feed data with specific parameters such as sorting and sharing identifiers.

methods.name: getAuthUserEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: setAuthUserEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: getShareId
methods.description: Returns the share ID filter if set.
